messages:
nina: Noticed a short-lived jump in 'per-token' cost for r-88 during the mistral rollout last night (~3.1x for 25m). Traffic steady. Suspect cache warmup + sampling blindspots. Anyone dug in?
omar: telemetry confirms cache-hit% fell from 92% -> 18% for r-88 right after canary. We have no route_id on a lot of sampled token events so attribution is fuzzy.
jia: On the cost dashboard the metric looks like a permanent regression. We should annotate the chart when a model variant rollout is in-flight so PMs know it's transient.
sam: two quick asks: 1) Add a rollout "cost preview" API that returns projected unit_cost and warmup window to show in the modal. 2) Add an optional auto-throttle: "pause canary if cost > baseline * 2 for > 5m".
lucy: UX: rollout modal should show "Projected warmup tax" + confidence band and a one-click checkbox to enable auto-throttle. Also a short FAQ blurb about amortization of cache savings.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary started route=r-88 -> mistral-24k-beta (canary=8%)
omar: For telemetry change: include route_id, model_variant, is_canary, and sample_weight on token samples. Example:```{event: "token_sample", route_id: "r-88", model_variant: "mistral-24k-beta", is_canary: true, cache_hit: false, tokens: 12, sample_weight: 8}```
sam: For the cost-preview API sketch (internal):```POST /internal/cost_preview {"route_id":"r-88","model_variant":"mistral-24k-beta","canary_pct":8} -> {"projected_unit_cost":0.0112,"warmup_minutes":22,"confidence":0.7}``` We can compute using recent token samples + a warmup model.
omar: Implementation note: upsample canary samples x6 for first 1 hour to reduce variance; increase sample_weight alternatively if ingest costs are a concern.
jia: Dashboard: overlay a transient "warmup band" on per-token chart and an inline indicator on route list that says "warmup: 22m (proj)". Also a tiny tooltip explaining how amortized cache savings work.
lucy: We'll mock the modal card and tooltip. UX will include the pause-on-cost surge setting and default it OFF.
nina: Action items: 1) telemetry: add fields + canonical sample_weight rules (omar). 2) infra: cost_preview endpoint + compute job (sam). 3) console: rollout modal + warmup overlay (jia/lucy). I'll open RFC and tag infra/ux/telemetry.
ops-bot: ops-bot: RFC created: RFC-2026 warmup-cost-preview (nina)
